title: Town Directory | Islip
column7: The Town directory lists Public Safety Enforcement, Code Enforcement, Harbor Police, Fire Prevention, and Parking Violations rather than a general town police department.

title: Town of Islip 2024 Adopted Budget Book
key_finding: The budget describes the Department of Public Safety Enforcement as a quality-of-life and enforcement unit rather than a general municipal police department.

title: Code Enforcement | Islip
column7: The Town's code-enforcement page describes specialized enforcement of building and town-code violations, not general criminal-law policing.

title: Village Governments | Islip
column7: The Town officially lists incorporated village governments inside Islip, confirming that the town is not a single undivided local service surface.

title: Public Safety | Suffolk County
key_finding: Suffolk County states that the Suffolk County Police Department provides all police services for the Suffolk County Police District, comprised of the five western towns including Islip.

title: Emergency Telephone Numbers | Suffolk County
key_finding: County emergency-contact materials use Suffolk County Police as the non-emergency incident-reporting surface and list a separate town emergency-management number for Islip.

title: Traffic Stops by Suffolk County Police
key_finding: County police materials map Islip communities into Suffolk County Police precinct geography rather than a town-specific police department.

title: Town of Islip and Suffolk County Police Take Action Against Illegal Cannabis Sales in Smoke and Vape Shops
key_finding: The Town describes itself as partnering with Suffolk County Police on enforcement activity, which is consistent with county police primary jurisdiction rather than an independent town police force.
